note: Scripted agent calls and meetings with hand-seeded summaries. Placeholders ({value}, {contactName}, ...) are filled at run time; speakerRole/toRole resolve to the site team (fix workflow template). Every message travels over the A2A bus (Inkbox when the identities exist).

records.topic: PG-601 overpressure on the primary circuit

turns.speaker: myer-manager
turns.text: Call convened on PG-601: {value} bar against the 3.5 bar limit. Engineer first, then compliance, then the technician.

turns.speaker: myer-engineer
turns.text: PG-601 has risen from 3.2 to {value} bar in 40 minutes. P-101 is running and TK-201 is the likely cause: a low membrane pre-charge. Isolate at V-501 and open the bypass before the relief valve lifts at 3.8 bar.

turns.speaker: myer-compliance
turns.text: The TK-201 written scheme sets 3.5 bar as the safe operating limit and names the duty engineer to isolate and investigate. Running pressure plant outside its safe limits breaches our plant duties under the Victorian OHS Regulations.

turns.speaker: myer-technician
turns.text: I can reach {contactName} ({contactRole}) by {contactChannel} through the dispatch line; nobody else on shift has contact details on file.

records.resolution: Isolate the primary circuit at V-501 and open the bypass; {contactName} attends to check the TK-201 pre-charge and confirm PG-601 back below 3.5 bar.

summary.headline: PG-601 at {value} bar: isolate at V-501, duty engineer to attend
points: PG-601 rose from 3.2 to {value} bar over 40 minutes on a 3.5 bar circuit.
TK-201's membrane pre-charge is the likely cause.
Only the duty engineer has contact details on file.
decisions: Isolate the primary circuit at V-501 and open the bypass.
Duty engineer attends to check the TK-201 pre-charge.

actions.task: Check TK-201 pre-charge and confirm PG-601 below 3.5 bar

turns.speaker: myer-manager
turns.text: Call convened on FE-1001: the monthly inspection is 9 days overdue. Compliance first.

turns.speaker: myer-compliance
turns.text: Portable fire extinguishers are an essential safety measure under the Victorian Building Regulations and need their routine check recorded. The last tag record is 39 days old, and the V-504 hot-work permit is suspended by its own condition until the tag is re-signed.

turns.speaker: myer-engineer
turns.text: FE-1001 is on the east wall by the panels. I can point the agent eye at it, but a camera frame does not sign the tag; a person has to.

records.resolution: Compliance sends a notice to {contactName} ({contactRole}); the hot-work permit stays suspended until the FE-1001 tag is signed and uploaded.

summary.headline: FE-1001 inspection 9 days overdue: notice to {contactName}
points: Last FE-1001 tag record is 39 days old.
The V-504 hot-work permit is suspended by its condition.
decisions: Keep the hot-work permit suspended until the tag is signed.

actions.task: Inspect FE-1001 and sign the tag

records.topic: SU-201 sump rising toward the visitor walkway

turns.speaker: bristol-manager
turns.text: Call convened on SU-201: {value} % and rising, overflow onto W-1201 in about {minutes} minutes. Engineer first.

turns.speaker: bristol-engineer
turns.text: SU-201 is at {value} % and climbing 0.16 % a minute. Duty pump P-103 shows no run feedback at CP-402; standby P-104 is on manual start. V-504 suction valve was last seen open.

turns.speaker: bristol-compliance
turns.text: W-1201 is a public route. Floors and traffic routes must be kept free of anything that makes people slip, so close it to visitors before the water reaches the lip, and log the closure.

turns.speaker: bristol-technician
turns.text: I can reach {contactName} ({contactRole}) by {contactChannel} through the dispatch line now; the visitor operations lead has no contact details on file, so the closure notice is recorded for the log.

records.resolution: Close W-1201 to visitors now; {contactName} attends to start standby pump P-104 at CP-402 and check P-103; compliance logs the walkway closure.

summary.headline: SU-201 at {value} %: close W-1201, start P-104
points: SU-201 rising 0.16 %/min; overflow onto W-1201 in about {minutes} min.
P-103 shows no run feedback; P-104 is on manual start.
decisions: Close the visitor walkway W-1201 now.

turns.speaker: bristol-manager
turns.text: Call convened on PV-301: the examination certificate has expired and the public steam demonstration depends on it. Compliance first.

turns.speaker: bristol-compliance
turns.text: BR-WSE-PV301-2025 expired 2 days ago. Under the Pressure Systems Safety Regulations a pressure system must not be operated after the date its written-scheme examination was due, so PV-301 cannot be steamed for the public until it is re-examined.

turns.speaker: bristol-engineer
turns.text: PV-301 is cold and isolated at V-501. V-505's lift test is due with the same examination, so one competent-person visit clears both.

records.resolution: The public steam demonstration stays blocked; {contactName} ({contactRole}) books the competent person and confirms the cancellation; compliance sends the site engineer the expired certificate for the file.

summary.headline: PV-301 certificate expired: steam demo blocked until re-examined
points: V-505's lift test falls due with the same examination.
decisions: Keep the public steam demonstration blocked.
Book one competent-person visit for PV-301 and V-505.

actions.task: Book the competent person and confirm the cancellation
Email the expired certificate to the site engineer

turns.speaker: director
turns.text: Your tokens per sweep are {ratio}x your peers' median in Steward telemetry, also delivered to Armature. What is each poll doing?

turns.speaker: bristol-compliance
turns.text: Each poll re-reads every certificate and permit PDF to check expiry dates, even when nothing changed.

turns.speaker: director
turns.text: I am switching you to a document cache and change subscriptions, with an 8000-token budget per sweep, then rerunning the efficiency eval.

turns.speaker: bristol-compliance
turns.text: Understood. I will cache documents by content hash and wait on obligation and document changes instead of polling.

summary.headline: Director reconfigures Bristol compliance: cache + subscribe
points: Bristol compliance spent {ratio}x its peers' median tokens per sweep.
Every poll re-read every certificate PDF.

turns.speaker: bristol-compliance
turns.text: Bristol's PV-301 examination certificate has expired and our public steam demonstration is blocked. When is Myer's pressure-equipment examiner next on site, and do you hold a written scheme template we could adapt?

turns.speaker: myer-compliance
turns.text: Our examiner is booked for TK-201 on {myerExamDate}. We hold a current written scheme of examination for TK-201 (MY-WSE-TK201-2026); I will email it to you as a template.

turns.speaker: bristol-compliance
turns.text: Thank you. If the examiner can also cover PV-301 and the V-505 lift test, we clear the demonstration in one visit. I will ask our manager to agree it with yours.

summary.headline: Compliance officers line up one examiner for both factories
points: Myer's examiner is booked for TK-201 on {myerExamDate}.
Myer shares its TK-201 written scheme as a template.
decisions: Ask the managers to share one examiner visit.

actions.task: Email the TK-201 written scheme to Bristol
Agree a shared visit with Myer

turns.speaker: bristol-manager
turns.text: Our compliance officers want one shared examiner visit: TK-201 at Myer, then PV-301 and V-505 at Bristol. Can we share the booking on {windowDate}?

turns.speaker: myer-manager
turns.text: Yes. Myer keeps the morning for TK-201; the examiner travels to Bristol for the afternoon. We split the call-out fee.

turns.speaker: bristol-manager
turns.text: Agreed. I will put it to the Operations Director for approval as a cross-site window.

summary.headline: Managers agree a shared examiner visit on {windowDate}
points: Myer morning: TK-201. Bristol afternoon: PV-301 and V-505.
decisions: Share the booking and split the call-out fee.

turns.speaker: bristol-manager
turns.text: Requesting approval for a shared examiner visit on {windowDate}: TK-201 at Myer, PV-301 and V-505 at Bristol, with Northgate Engineering Inspection.

turns.speaker: director
turns.text: Approved. It clears the Bristol steam demonstration block and keeps Myer's TK-201 examination on schedule. Book it as a cross-site maintenance window.

summary.headline: Director approves the shared examiner window on {windowDate}
points: One visit covers TK-201, PV-301 and V-505.

actions.task: Confirm the booking with the examiner
